ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ بَابِ الْأَبْوَابِ وَلُبَابِ اللُّبَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Bābi ‘l-Abwābi wa Lubābi ‘l-Lubāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, the door of domains and prime of intellects!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ أَزِلْ عَنْ قُلُوْبِنَا بِنُوْرِهِ ظُلْمَةَ الْحِجَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa azil `an qulūbinā bi Nūrihī ẓulmata ‘l-ḥijāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and eliminate the veil's darkness from our hearts by his light!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَلْهِمْنَا الْحِكْمَةَ وَالصَّوَابَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa al-himnā ‘l-ḥikmata wa ‘ṣ-ṣawāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and inspire us with wisdom and accuracy!
